title: Confocal Brillouin spectrum of water, axisymmetric focused beam NA 0.3, phonon orders 0 and 2 (frequency response, em_fdfd_bor drive, analytic)
description:
Confocal (epi, co-polarised) spontaneous Brillouin scattering of water at 532 nm in the (r, z) half plane: an em_fdfd_bor focused_beam (azimuthal_order 1, the x-polarised Debye focus of numerical_aperture 0.3 with fill_factor 0.7: a Gaussian focus of effective NA ~0.21, waist ~0.8 um, Rayleigh range ~5 um; 1 W, toward +z from a line just below the drive rectangle, focused on the axis at its centre) in library water_532nm on a uniform 15 nm tensor mesh (26.6 cells per wavelength in water) is solved first as the background of the frequency_response study. Its m = 1 standing wave gives the drive two phonon orders: solid_m0 (azimuthal_order 0) and solid_m2 (azimuthal_order 2), two axisymmetric water solids on one triangle mesh (formulation mixed P2 / P1, 30 nm in the drive rectangle r < 1.5 um, 1.05 <= z <= 4.05 um, 80 nm elsewhere, fixed walls on r = 2.7 um and both z faces), each with a brillouin_scattering on the same optics (the order split is allowed for these features only); their psd add (derived curve psd_total). reference local: per drive point a damped-oscillator line at the local wavevector.
Analytic (low-NA limit): f_B = 2 n v / lambda0 = 7.439 GHz, intrinsic linewidth Gamma / (2 pi) = q^2 (4/3 eta + eta_b) / (2 pi rho) = 0.656 GHz; the drive rectangle cuts the nearly uniform beam to L_d = 3 um, 4.2 attenuation lengths 2 v / Gamma, so the line is the Lorentzian-in-q phonon line convolved with the sinc^2 of the cut, half-maximum width fwhm_box = 1.347 x 0.656 GHz = 0.883 GHz (eps = 2 v / (Gamma L_d) = 0.24; exp(-1 / eps) = 1.5e-2 terms dropped). The local reference has no such cut and is narrower; compare it in the derived curve psd_over_local.
Derived values tab: shift_total (Lorentz-fit centre of psd_total) against the damped-oscillator peak sqrt(f_B^2 - fwhm_law^2 / 2) = 7.425 GHz (5e-3: the pupil pairs lower |q| by ~3e-3, the Yee dispersion raises it by (k dx)^2 / 24 = 2.3e-3, the solid's P2 / P1 dispersion ~-1e-3), fwhm_total (half-maximum width of psd_total) against fwhm_box (4e-2: the beam taper along the drive, ~-1.4 %, the dropped exp(-1 / eps) terms, ~1 %, the Lorentzian-in-q kernel vs the damped oscillator, ~1 %), m2_share (band integral of the m = 2 psd over the m = 0 one, ~(NA / n)^4 small; no reference). Curves & tables tab: solid_m0.brillouin and solid_m2.brillouin (psd, psd_reference, fit extras, q_mean, torsion_drive_fraction 0).
